steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Now that all the performers are set, the stage is ready for the spectacular final act.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: With his longsword in hand, he embarks on a journey tailor-made for him.
steps.female_content: With her longsword in hand, she embarks on a journey tailor-made for her.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: All eyes are fixed in anticipation, eager to see his take on the unfolding drama, curious about the choices he will make...
steps.female_content: All eyes are fixed in anticipation, eager to see her take on the unfolding drama, curious about the choices she will make...

steps.content: Amidst the deserted audience seats, a solitary figure with a broad hat sits, seemingly in a dialogue with an invisible companion.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: If this performance lives up to my expectations, I may want to put on this show again by the same time next year.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: This could be Fortuna's biggest blockbuster, the jewel in my crown.
